{{Top}}
[[File:StormIV_btm.jpg|thumb|250px|A [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]] flying through [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].]]
{{Quote|If you can bribe a member of Bespin's Wing Guard into taking you on a spin around Cloud City, you won't regret spending your credits. The views are stunning.|Excerpt from [[Ullok's Underground Guide to Bespin]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
'''Cloud cars''' were small, atmospheric craft used for various purposes. Manufacturers of cloud cars included [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]], [[Ubrikkian Yards]], and [[Bakur RepulsorCorp]].

Cloud cars were a common sight in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], especially the [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]] used by the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]].
